name: comp-332
blurb: Multi-step onboarding dialog with progress indicators and skip option.
description: A shadcn Dialog with 4 steps, each displaying an image, title, and description; progress dots show current position; next/okay buttons advance.
use_when: Guiding new users through product features or setup with informational steps.
avoid_when: For complex workflows requiring data collection between steps — this is a read-only tour.
a11y: Dialog has proper header and description; progress dots are visual-only; buttons labeled; keyboard navigation supported; skip and close both exit.
